programs.name: closed_neighborhood_reward
programs.rationale: Divides reward by closed-neighborhood size to favor contacts that preserve choices. Reach is the immediate unweighted neighborhood; arithmetic is constant cost, while supplied degree updates remain charged.

programs.name: weighted_conflict_share
programs.rationale: Multiplies reward by its share of the weighted closed neighborhood, accounting for heterogeneous blockers. Reach is local conflict mass; arithmetic is constant cost, while maintaining that aggregate still requires active-set work.

programs.name: strongest_rival_margin
programs.rationale: Ranks a strongest-rival exchange margin with a discounted average of additional blocker mass. Reach is the immediate weighted neighborhood; constant arithmetic adds no graph traversal, but blocker compatibility remains unknown.
programs.rule: weight - max_conflict_weight - 0.25 * max(0, conflict_weight - max_conflict_weight) / (1 + degree)

programs.name: residual_fraction_balance
programs.rationale: Balances reward against the fraction of active contacts blocked and adds a bounded compatible-weight bonus. Reach includes residual aggregate totals; arithmetic is constant cost, although those totals must track active-set changes.
programs.rule: weight * (1 + compatible_weight / (1 + weight + conflict_weight + compatible_weight)) / (1 + 2 * degree / max(1, remaining_count - 1))

programs.name: resource_reward_rate
programs.rationale: Approximates reward per occupied resource time using duration and both actual root gaps. Reach is root-only, with constant arithmetic and no added graph work; the symmetric gap contribution is an occupancy proxy.

programs.name: bottleneck_gap_pressure
programs.rationale: Combines a saturated duration benefit based on the larger resource gap with count and weighted conflict pressure. Reach covers root attributes and its neighborhood; arithmetic is constant cost, with ordinary conflict-summary update costs retained.
programs.rule: weight * (1 + duration / (1 + duration + max(station_gap, satellite_gap))) / (1 + degree + 0.5 * conflict_weight / (1 + max_conflict_weight))

programs.name: exchange_regime_switch
programs.rationale: Handles isolated contacts directly, credits roots whose reward covers total blocker weight, and discounts contested roots otherwise. Reach is one neighborhood; bounded conditionals add constant arithmetic, with base updates still charged.
programs.rule: weight if degree == 0 else (weight + 0.5 * (weight - conflict_weight) if weight >= conflict_weight else weight / (1 + degree + conflict_weight / (1 + weight)))

programs.name: bounded_conflict_pivot
programs.rationale: Adds bounded conflict-density and conflict-mass bonuses to reward, then penalizes the strongest rival. Reach includes residual summaries; arithmetic is constant cost, but aggregate updates remain charged and centrality can trade against greedy inclusion quality.
programs.rule: weight * (1 + 0.5 * degree / max(1, remaining_count - 1) + 0.5 * conflict_weight / (1 + weight + conflict_weight + compatible_weight)) - 0.25 * max_conflict_weight
